As Illumina (ILMN) Stock Rose, First Mercantile Trust Co Has Raised Its Stake; Etrade Capital Management Has Cut Its Sanofi (SNY) Stake by $772,151; Market Value Declined
May 21, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
First Mercantile Trust Co increased its stake in Illumina Inc (ILMN) by 96.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Mercantile Trust Co bought 2,145 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.04% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,377 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $956,000, up from 2,232 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Mercantile Trust Co who had been investing in Illumina Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $39.64 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.45% or $1.22 during the last trading session, reaching $269.67. About 438,237 shares traded. Illumina, Inc. (NASDAQ:ILMN) has risen 37.77% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 26.22% the S&P500.
Etrade Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 24.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Etrade Capital Management Llc sold 17,957 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,758 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.36 million, down from 72,715 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Etrade Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $96.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $38.88. About 1.30 million shares traded or 10.68% up from the average. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
